---
title: "Age"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(tidycensus)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
cleveland_age <- get_acs(
  geography = "tract",
  variables = c(median_age = "B01002_001"),
  state = "OH",
  county = "Cuyahoga",
  year = 2022
)

cleveland_age |>
  drop_na(estimate) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = estimate)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 3, fill = "steelblue", color = "white") +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Median Age in the Cleveland Area",
    subtitle = "By census tract in Cuyahoga County, Ohio (2022)",
    x = "Median Age (years)",
    y = "Number of Census Tracts",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2018–2022 ACS 5-year estimates."
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
